name: Cooks Coffee Company Limited
summary: Cooks Coffee Company Limited is an enterprise primarily engaged in the food and beverage sector, operating alongside its various subsidiaries. The company's core business involves both running and franchising Esquires Coffee establishments across a significant international reach, encompassing the United Kingdom, Ireland, Portugal, Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Indonesia. Additionally, it holds ownership of the Triple Two Coffee brand and distributes a selection of food and drink items under its CRUX brand name. By October 5, 2022, the company managed a network of 111 outlets. Formerly known as Cooks Global Foods Limited, the organization adopted its current name, Cooks Coffee Company Limited, in March 2022. Established in 2008, its corporate base is located in Auckland, New Zealand.
